panel.introduction: Albiorix belongs to Saturn’s Gallic group of outer moons. This ellipsoid illustrates a lightcurve-based minimum elongation, with assumed depth and orientation. The grid marks unmapped terrain.

controls.label: Shape model
controls.description: Approximate ellipsoid adopting the published minimum equatorial ratio 1.34:1 under uniform reflectivity. Equal short axes, volume scaling and orientation are assumed. The grid marks unmapped terrain.

charts.alt: JWST/NIRSpec PRISM · 2023-11-22. Archive point-source extraction, pipeline 2.0.1. Flux density with propagated 1σ errors; flagged samples are omitted from the plot and retained in the CSV. No solar-spectrum division or thermal subtraction has been applied, so this is not the published relative-reflectance spectrum. The combined archive product includes a dither reported to contain a background source; its flux may be contaminated.
